BLANKTHESPIRE-IMPORT_CLASS_CODE.title: Class code
BLANKTHESPIRE-IMPORT_CLASS_SLOT.title: Class slot (0 = auto)
BLANKTHESPIRE-IMPORT_CLASS.title: Import class into a slot
BLANKTHESPIRE-IMPORT_CLASS.hover.desc: Paste a class (BTSC) code from blankthespire.com into the "Class code" field, then press Import. Slot 0 picks automatically: it updates a same-named class, or takes the lowest empty slot.
BLANKTHESPIRE-CLEAR_CLASS.title: Clear one class slot
BLANKTHESPIRE-CLEAR_CLASS.hover.desc: Removes the forged class in the selected slot. Set "Class slot" above to 1 or higher first.
BLANKTHESPIRE-CLEAR_ALL_CLASSES.title: Delete ALL forged classes
BLANKTHESPIRE-CLEAR_ALL_CLASSES.hover.de: Removes every imported class at once. This cannot be undone.
BLANKTHESPIRE-RESTART_GAME.title: Restart game (applies changes)
BLANKTHESPIRE-RESTART_GAME.hover.desc: Closes the game and reopens it automatically via Steam. Imported or cleared classes only take effect after a restart.
